rationale: Asmita's deep expertise in post-training, alignment, and responsible AI research pairs well with Hercules's focus on AI agents and human-AI collaboration in engineering—two complementary angles on making AI systems more reliable and effective. Asmita's background spanning research (NVIDIA, Cisco) and production systems (Google Payments) complements Hercules's experience building product AI at scale (Brex), and both share conviction that context management and thoughtful system design are critical as AI capabilities grow.
intro_message: Asmita Hajra, meet Hercules Giaretta Gimenes — you're both working on the hard problems of making AI systems smarter and safer: Asmita on post-training alignment and responsible AI, Hercules on agentic tools and human-AI collaboration at Brex.
